title: Complete trash
text: Complete trash. [[VIDEOID:9bf082ab92849cfcd31fc80580f77b2e]] This office desk is my nightmare. First of all, I received the main part that’s already damaged, see photo 1. Photo 2 and video show that the parts are impossible to assemble because it’s off, just like the other one star review shows there. Also, the four edges are super sharp, I got multiple cuts oh my leg and finger because of the sharp edges. Lastly, the last photo shows that the height is very low, even I set up my chair to the lowest, it’s still very low for me to use. If you have a regular height chair, you have to look down your computer the whole time. And it hurts my neck so much from using this desk. You’ll have to buy a extremely low chair to fit it. Overall, this is completely waste of money
